title: AI Spokesperson Video Maker for Product Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Make an AI spokesperson video from one product photo. Choose a person and a scene, write your selling point, and download a talking 9:16 ad.
h1: AI Spokesperson Video: Explain One Product Point on Camera
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into an AI spokesperson video: a generated presenter holds your item and says the line you wrote. No casting, no studio day, no creator brief. Choose a frame, pick 6 to 30 seconds, and download a clip for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts.
benefits_h2: Use Cases for an On-Camera Product Showcase

benefits.d: Put one product benefit in a vertical ad and test the offer. You are not paying a creator for every new angle.
Place the clip next to your listing photos so shoppers hear one feature before they buy. The presenter is generated, not a customer.
Reuse the same upload with a new line or a new scene when TikTok, Reels, or Shorts needs another angle. Each version is its own clip.
Walk through setup, sizing, or daily use in a spoken clip so buyers know what to do after delivery. You write the line.

steps_h2: How to Make an AI Spokesperson Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Put one product point you can stand behind on camera, then download a file you can test.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo with the whole item visible. The product in the ad comes from this picture.
Pick a presenter and a setting, then write the one line they should say. Choose a frame and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the clip when it is ready. Add captions, a price, or licensed music in your editor, then post it.

faq.q: What is an AI spokesperson video?
faq.a: It is a short ad where a generated presenter holds your product and explains one line you approved. You start with one product photo.

faq.q: How do I give the spokesperson a script?
faq.a: Type one short sentence for them to say. The presenter says that line. Review the take before you post.

faq.q: Can I choose the person and the setting?
faq.a: Yes. Choose from the adult presenter scenes on this page, then match the setting to where the product is used. Takes can vary, so review each one.
Handheld items with one clear feature work well, including skincare, snacks, drinks, pet supplies, and fitness gear. Keep the product fully visible in the source photo.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a creator?
faq.a: A creator films with your real product and may improvise. An AI spokesperson starts from your photo and follows your line, so you can make another version without a new booking.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, and 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A 9:16 frame is the usual one for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

faq.q: How many credits does a spokesperson video use?
faq.a: A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. The cost shows before you start, and a failed job gives the credits back.

faq.q: Do I own the clip, and can I run it as an ad?
faq.a: Yes. Finished clips can be used commercially and have no watermark. Add any AI label the platform requires before you spend.

faq.q: Is the spokesperson a real customer?
faq.a: No. It is a generated presenter, not a buyer or a reviewer. Use the clip to explain the product, and do not invent a customer experience.

faq.q: Can I add captions, a price, or music after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add captions, your price, and licensed music in your editor. This tool does not add them for you.

faq.q: Can I pick a voice library or another language?
faq.a: No. You write the line and choose a presenter and a scene. There is no voice list and no language switch. Review the spoken take before you post.
